purpose: Resolve the one Campaign008 concept into one exact and finite no-value mechanism. This audit freezes formula, direction, causal timestamp alignment, zero and missing semantics, rejects alternative definitions, and challenges the mechanism against all 31 prior minute comparisons before any external minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

comparison_catalog.score_direction_normalization: Multiply lower-is-better comparison values by minus one before each daily rank correlation; retain the candidate's frozen higher direction.

candidate.name: intraday_post_shock_share_volume_replenishment_236p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A price shock followed by expanding executed share quantity indicates rapid information confirmation or liquidity replenishment rather than an isolated mark. Higher post-shock volume response may therefore persist from the next open through the third close.
candidate.formula: PearsonCorr(abs(log(close_t/close_t-1)), log(volume_t+1/volume_t)) over retained within-half one-minute post-shock response pairs
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude the standalone 09:30 row, and use the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.
Require all 240 selected closes to be finite and strictly positive and all 240 selected share-volume values to be finite and nonnegative.

Inside each 120-bar half, index bars from 0 through 119. For each t from 1 through 118, compute the absolute shock abs(log(close_t/close_t-1)) and align it only with the subsequent one-minute share-volume growth log(volume_t+1/volume_t).
This creates exactly 118 possible response pairs per half and at most 236 pairs per stock-day. The 09:30 row, lunch transition, cross-half pair, and any response beyond the final bar are excluded.

For a proposed response pair, both-zero volume_t and volume_t+1 make only that pair inactive. Exactly one zero endpoint invalidates the entire stock-day. No volume value is filled, shifted across a half, or replaced.
Require at least 120 retained pairs. This threshold is frozen before coverage observation and does not vary by stock, date, or year.
Require every retained shock and growth value to be finite and require strictly positive population variance in both retained vectors; otherwise the stock-day is missing.

Return their unweighted Pearson correlation. Canonicalize only floating-point endpoints within 1e-12 of -1 or +1; do not otherwise clip, winsorize, rank, smooth, impute, amount-weight, volume-weight, threshold, or residualize the value.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Within each half-session pair the price shock ending at t strictly precedes the volume-growth response from t to t+1. There are 118 possible pairs per half, no standalone 09:30 row, no lunch transition, and no cross-half or overnight response.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: Both-zero response-volume endpoints remove only that pair; a one-sided zero response invalidates the stock-day. Fewer than 120 retained pairs or a constant shock or response vector is missing.
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Amount-volatility coupling is synchronous and correlates destination-bar log amount level with the absolute return ending at that same bar. This candidate instead uses the next one-minute change in executed share quantity, so response occurs after the shock and no amount is read.

Amount-lead-return correlation runs from earlier activity to the next close return. This candidate reverses the causal order: an already-observed absolute close shock is followed by share-volume growth.

Negative-return absorption and directional price-impact mechanisms condition on return sign or divide displacement by activity. This candidate is sign-symmetric, estimates neither absorption nor impact, and applies no return-state filter.

Campaign007 correlates synchronous share-volume changes with transaction-price returns and forbids close. This candidate reads close, forbids amount and transaction price, uses an absolute shock, and aligns only a subsequent share-volume change.
Activity-profile persistence and timing mechanisms describe the full-day volume or amount shape without conditioning on a preceding price shock. This candidate is a local causal response statistic.
rejected_variants_before_values: same-bar, earlier-volume-to-later-return, multi-lag, lead-lag search, regression beta, R-squared, rank correlation, mutual information, sign-conditioned, or thresholded response
signed, squared, clipped, winsorized, direction-inverted, lower-is-better, or return-magnitude-weighted alternatives
amount, transaction price, VWAP, open, high, low, daily values, market or industry benchmarks, or any provider substitution
including 09:30, the lunch transition, overnight response, morning-only, afternoon-only, late-only, or another lag/window
changing the 120-pair minimum, treating one-sided zeros as inactive, filling zero volume, carrying values forward, filtering years or stocks, or combining with terminal factors

frozen_no_return_and_search_bounds.coverage_basis: finite candidate rows divided by quality-and-listing eligible buyable rows within 2019-2025

decision.required_next_step: Implement and synthetically test only this exact formula, then freeze a hash-bound no-return protocol before external candidate or comparison values. Apply coverage and capacity first; read comparison values only if those gates pass; read no daily price or forward return until the exact one-trial walk-forward preregistration is frozen.
